apply_chromatic_translation_augmentation: apply random color translation augmentation to sparse tensor features using ChromaticTranslation
apply_chromatic_autocontrast_augmentatio: apply auto contrast augmentation to sparse tensor RGB features using ChromaticAutoContrast
apply_chromatic_jitter_augmentation: apply random Gaussian noise jitter to sparse tensor RGB features using ChromaticJitter
apply_hue_saturation_augmentation: apply hue and saturation translation augmentation to RGB features using HueSaturationTranslation
compose_transform_pipeline: compose multiple augmentation transforms into a single pipeline using the Compose class
